page.overview:
Who is Cotera?

When first meeting , she is cocooned in a thorny flower bud and begs to listen as she explains her sad state. If he agrees, she introduces herself and tells him about her home. A lack of travelers and offerings have left her utterly drained, giving her no choice but to ask for 's help. She requests several from . The number changes based on how many has already helped. assures that she will aid him once she is back to her old self and extends a hand from the bud to accept his offering. Should refuse to help her, she retracts her hand with disappointment.

Once gives her the appropriate amount of , thanks him and is able to regain her power. She bursts from the renewed completely refreshed, expressing her joy. To thank him for his part in her rejuvenation, offers her assistance to in the form of enhancing his .

How much Cotera will be able to enhance Link's Armor depends on how many of her sisters have been assisted. Whenever uses her power, she urges to allow her to handle the work. will occasionally mention set bonuses when she enhances 's clothing, pointing out how they work. Once decides to stop, will mention her sisters and request that he help them as well.
